comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
This crash comes from a 1.82.0 portable install whose `ExternalConnectors.dll` is missing from the application folder — the app tried to load it the moment a connection was opened and the file was not there. That DLL ships in every release archive, so on a healthy extract this cannot happen. The two usual causes:

1. **Partial update/extract** — the ZIP was unpacked over an existing folder and some files were skipped, or only `mRemoteNG.exe` was copied. Related stale-file problems are exactly wh...

comments.snippet:
This report was filed automatically by the crash reporter, so we cannot ask the person who hit it — but it reproduced here, and it turned out to be hiding something worse than the crash itself.

What we did: took the built application, renamed `ExternalConnectors.dll` out of its folder, and started it.
